style: literary, poetic, lyrical prose aimed at a general/educated audience

responses.text: A billion years ago, two black holes spiraled into embrace, and spacetime shuddered—ripples cast outward like rings from a stone dropped in a cosmic pond. Through the long dark they traveled, stretching and squeezing the void, passing galaxies mid-birth, nebulae unfurling, stars kindling and dying. Undimmed by distance, patient as eternity, the waves whispered across the emptiness while Earth cooled, oceans rose, and life crawled from the sea. At last, faint as a tremor thinner than a proton's width, they brushed the mirrored arms of LIGO, and humanity, listening for the first time, heard the universe's ancient heartbeat.

For a billion years they traveled, faithful messengers carrying the memory of cosmic collision, their amplitude fading to an almost imperceptible sigh — a distortion smaller than a proton's width. Until at last, on an ordinary autumn day, they brushed against LIGO's laser-lit arms, and the universe's ancient secret was finally heard.
